Four-Stage Framework

The LEAD Stages

Four precisely designed stages aligned with leadership levels across Saudi Ground Services Company — each with a dedicated program journey, measurable outcomes, and transparent pricing.

01
LEAD 1
Foundation
👥 Team Leads & Supervisors

Build the essential mindset, skills, and habits of effective leadership — transitioning from individual contributor to inspiring team leader within the SGS environment.

Master core leadership fundamentals
Develop high-performing team communication
Apply performance management basics
Build emotional intelligence & self-awareness
Investment
SAR 8,500
02
LEAD 2
Elevation
👔 Managers & Senior Managers

Master leading teams and delivering results — moving beyond operational management into genuine strategic influence within your SGS function.

Develop strategic thinking capabilities
Become a certified coach & mentor
Lead cross-functional SGS initiatives
Drive and sustain organizational change
Investment
SAR 14,000
03
LEAD 3
Ascent
🏢 Directors & Senior Directors

Amplify organizational impact — leading at scale, shaping SGS culture, and positioning your function as a driver of enterprise-wide transformation.

Lead large-scale organizational change
Cultivate executive presence & gravitas
Apply advanced business acumen
Champion innovation & transformation
Investment
SAR 22,000
04
LEAD 4
Pinnacle
🌟 VPs & C-Suite Executives

Define the future of SGS — leading with vision, shaping the organization's destiny, and creating the ecosystem in which all LEAD leaders thrive.

Craft and articulate bold strategic vision
Navigate board & stakeholder complexity
Drive enterprise-wide transformation
Build lasting legacy & succession pipeline
Investment
SAR 38,000
Our Story

How We Built
the LEAD Program

LEAD emerged from deep listening, rigorous research, and co-creation with SGS leaders at every level of the organization.

🔍
Phase 01
Listening & Discovery

60+ structured interviews. Competency gaps mapped. Global aviation benchmarks analyzed.

🏗️
Phase 02
Architecture & Curation

Four-stage LEAD framework co-created. World-class vendors evaluated & selected.

🚀
Phase 04
Launch & Evolution

Organization-wide rollout. Continuous improvement via KPIs & Executive Committee input.

Your Experience

The LEAD Journey
Step by Step

Step 1 — Assess

Know Where You Stand

Comprehensive leadership assessment and structured nomination identifies your strengths, development priorities, and the right LEAD stage. Your personalized roadmap begins here.

Step 2 — Learn

Immersive Learning Experiences

World-class workshops, masterclasses, executive speakers, case studies, and simulations tailored to your LEAD stage — challenging, provoking, and inspiring action in your SGS context.

Step 3 — Apply

Lead in the Real World

Stretch assignments, cross-functional projects, and peer coaching circles where you apply new skills against real SGS business challenges — supported every step of the way.

Step 4 — Certify

Earn Your LEAD Credential

Complete your stage portfolio, receive your 360° feedback report, and earn your verified SGS LEAD credential — recognized at Executive Committee level.

Step 5 — Advance

Build Your Leadership Legacy

Join the LEAD alumni network, advance to the next stage, mentor the next cohort. Your development never stops — it evolves with you and SGS's strategic ambitions.

Program Design

Built on Three
Core Pillars

The architectural principles that make LEAD not just a training program, but a transformational leadership system for SGS.

🎯

Intentional Design

Every module, workshop, and experience is purposefully sequenced for maximum developmental impact. Nothing is accidental — everything serves your growth and SGS's strategic goals.

100%aligned to SGS leadership competency framework
🤝

Peer Cohort Power

You grow alongside a curated cohort of peers at your exact leadership level — building deep professional bonds and a shared language of leadership that unifies SGS across functions.

25leaders per cohort — small enough for depth, large enough for diversity
📈

Measurable Growth

Clear metrics, 360-degree feedback, and portfolio-based assessment ensure your development is visible, tangible, and recognized. Every LEAD graduate receives a verified digital credential.

3×promotion rate among LEAD graduates vs. non-participants
A Message from SGS

Building the Future of
Aviation Leadership
at Saudi Ground Services

A Builder of Saudi Talent

At Saudi Ground Services, we believe that the future of aviation is shaped not only by aircraft, infrastructure, or technology — but by the people who lead it. LEAD is our long-term commitment to building that human capability from within.

LEAD is more than a development program. It is SGS's declaration that our people are our runway to the future — and that the next generation of aviation leadership in the Kingdom will be designed, developed, and delivered right here at Saudi Ground Services.
